SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    stores.name AS "orders.stores.name",
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.ordered_at) AS "orders.ordered_at",
    SUM(orders.subtotal) / 100.0 AS "orders.sales",
    SUM(orders.subtotal) AS "orders.subtotal_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN stores AS stores
    ON orders.store_id = stores.id
  WHERE
    (
      orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
    )
  GROUP BY
    stores.name,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.ordered_at)
), _cm_subtotal_sum AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.stores.name" AS "stores__name",
    _stage_inner."orders.ordered_at_month" AS "ordered_at_month",
    _stage_inner."orders.subtotal_sum" AS "subtotal_sum"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      stores.name AS "orders.stores.name",
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.ordered_at) AS "orders.ordered_at_month",
      SUM(orders.subtotal) AS "orders.subtotal_sum"
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN stores AS stores
      ON orders.store_id = stores.id
    WHERE
      (
        orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
        AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    GROUP BY
      stores.name,
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.ordered_at)
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _cm_orders___avg_partition_by_stores_name AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders.stores.name" AS "orders.stores.name",
    CAST(AVG(_base._v) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.avg_subtotal_sum"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      stores.name AS "orders.stores.name",
      stores.name AS _ek0,
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.ordered_at) AS _ek1,
      MAX(_cm_subtotal_sum."subtotal_sum") AS _v
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN stores AS stores
      ON orders.store_id = stores.id
    LEFT JOIN _cm_subtotal_sum
      ON stores.name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_subtotal_sum."stores__name"
      AND DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.ordered_at) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_subtotal_sum."ordered_at_month"
    WHERE
      (
        orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
        AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
      )
    GROUP BY
      stores.name,
      stores.name,
      DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.ordered_at)
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base."orders.stores.name"
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders.stores.name",
    _base."orders.ordered_at",
    _base."orders.sales",
    _cm_orders___avg_partition_by_stores_name."orders.avg_subtotal_sum" / 100 AS "orders.avg_month",
    _base."orders.subtotal_sum" / NULLIF(_cm_orders___avg_partition_by_stores_name."orders.avg_subtotal_sum", 0) - 1 AS "orders.above",
    _base."orders.subtotal_sum",
    _cm_orders___avg_partition_by_stores_name."orders.avg_subtotal_sum" AS "orders.avg_subtotal_sum"
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_orders___avg_partition_by_stores_name
    ON _base."orders.stores.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders___avg_partition_by_stores_name."orders.stores.name"
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "orders.stores.name",
    "orders.ordered_at",
    "orders.sales",
    "orders.subtotal_sum",
    "orders.avg_month",
    "orders.above",
    "orders.avg_subtotal_sum",
    CASE
      WHEN "orders.subtotal_sum" IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      ELSE RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY "orders.stores.name", CASE WHEN "orders.subtotal_sum" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ORDER BY "orders.subtotal_sum" DESC
      )
    END AS "orders._rank_inner"
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  "orders.stores.name",
  "orders.ordered_at",
  "orders.sales",
  "orders.avg_month",
  "orders.above"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "orders.stores.name",
    "orders.ordered_at",
    "orders.sales",
    "orders.subtotal_sum",
    "orders.avg_month",
    "orders.above",
    "orders.avg_subtotal_sum",
    "orders._rank_inner"
  FROM step1
  WHERE
    "orders._rank_inner" <= 1
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "orders.stores.name" ASC,
  "orders.ordered_at" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message: Best 2025 month by pre-tax sales (net sales, stored in cents and divided by 100 to get dollars) for each store. Each store's average covers only the 2025 months in which it had orders, which I treated as the months it was open; opening dates in the store records were not checked. The last column is best month divided by the average, minus 1.
